sources.vm.nox.noun:
module vm.nox.noun

// Native immutable values; allocation and failed projections can trap.
#[pure]
#[ensures(as_field(result) == value)]
#[intrinsic(nox_noun_atom)]
pub fn atom(value: Field) -> Noun

#[pure]
#[ensures(eq(head(result), left))]
#[ensures(eq(tail(result), right))]
#[intrinsic(nox_noun_pair)]
pub fn pair(left: Noun, right: Noun) -> Noun

// Requires a pair. Projection of an atom fails execution.
#[pure]
#[ensures(eq(pair(result, tail(value)), value))]
#[intrinsic(nox_noun_head)]
pub fn head(value: Noun) -> Noun

#[pure]
#[ensures(eq(pair(head(value), result), value))]
#[intrinsic(nox_noun_tail)]
pub fn tail(value: Noun) -> Noun

// Requires an atom. Projection of a pair fails execution.
#[pure]
#[ensures(eq(atom(result), value))]
#[intrinsic(nox_noun_as_field)]
pub fn as_field(value: Noun) -> Field

#[pure]
#[ensures(result == (identity(a) == identity(b)))]
#[intrinsic(nox_noun_eq)]
pub fn eq(a: Noun, b: Noun) -> Bool

#[pure]
#[intrinsic(nox_noun_identity)]
pub fn identity(value: Noun) -> Digest
